Description

Need an 7-a-side football pitch in east London? Jubilee Sports Ground boasts a spectacular 7-a-side 3G astroturf football pitch which is available for footballers looking for a one-off game or a regular block booking. It is a full size pitch that is available to book for one-off training sessions or a season long league. Check with the facility about hiring officials and other equipment.

The venue is surrounded by floodlights which makes this facility perfect all year around. The lights will be turned off by the facility once all sports bookings have been completed.

If you’re driving then it is worth noting that there are not any free parking spaces provided by the venue. There are spaces available to park your car but these are pay and display areas and are monitored.

Customers will be pleased to know that the venue operates a pay-as-you-play booking system. This means sports enthusiasts can just turn up and play depending on availability and book on a pay as you play basis. This method avoids the monthly membership charges and gives you the freedom to play as and when you like.

If a one-off game isn't enough, then why not take advantage of the block booking option at Jubilee Sports Ground? Block bookings are a great way to guarantee a weekly game and socialise with your friends. It also takes the hassle out of paying before each game and collecting money from teammates as there is a one-time payment.

There are smart and spacious changing rooms available for customers, with well-maintained facilities. This means customers can come straight from work or head out straight after.

The venue is situated near Highams Park station. From there it is a short walk to the facility which works out well for a gentle warm down after your booking.
